{{Top|leg}}
A '''laser screen'''<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was an foldable [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-resistant [[Metal/Legends|metal]] apron.<ref name="CoF">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref> The modified [[XL-Lioness]] [[TDL nanny droid]] that was charged with the protection of [[Anakin Solo]] at [[Anoth Base]] had a laser screen<ref name="EGTD" /> equipped at the base of her torso. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] deployed it to protect the child from [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Furgan]].<ref name="CoF" />
